newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks end lower on pre-budget nerves.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks end lower on pre-budget nerves.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index closed lower on Friday but off the day's worst levels and with a net gain on the week, despite the market's fixation with next Wednesday's UK Budget.
"We are not so much running up to the Budget but stumbling," one trader said. But UK blue-chips still managed a 45-point gain on the week.

The FTSE 100 ended 17.6 points lower at 4,640.3 after being dragged up from its low of 4,623.1 by a strong performance in New York. The Dow was up 70 points as London markets closed but the U.S. rally could not overcome the pre-Budget jitters.
